# the second stack is selected: it comes out first
MENU A cid=0 type=inventory state=8 carried=minecraft:stick*2
MS 9 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 10 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 11 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 12 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 13 minecraft:stick*4
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140007000000
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140008000901810901003402f407030000ef07010000
PKT A minecraft:set_cursor_item 6202a4080000
# the same index twice clears the selection: the first stack comes out
MENU A cid=0 type=inventory state=11 carried=minecraft:diamond*3
MS 9 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 10 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 11 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 12 minecraft:bundle*1{minecraft:bundle_contents:[{count:3,id:"minecraft:diamond"},{count:2,id:"minecraft:stick"},{id:"minecraft:apple"}]}
MS 13 minecraft:stick*4
MS 20 minecraft:stick*2
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140009001402a4080000
PKT A minecraft:set_cursor_item 6200

PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 14000b000a01810901003402a408020000ef07010000
PKT A minecraft:set_cursor_item 6203f4070000
